_comment: Claude CLI backend config. Copy to claude_cli_config.json. Each model name maps to a `claude --print --model <name>` invocation; `claude-code` is a sentinel that runs the CLI without --model so it uses its current default. Auth comes from %USERPROFILE%/.claude/ — run `claude /login` once on the host as the user that owns the Artifex process.

claude-code._comment: No --model flag passed; CLI picks its current default.
